contexts.text: Nothing with man is regarded by the Lord except the end.
Man can look upwards... and can look downwards. Explained.
Look towards heaven (). Explained.
Not to look to doctrinal things. Signified, Explained. AC 2454, Explained.
To regard the doctrine of faith from rational things; and... to regard rational things from the doctrine of faith. Explained.

The doctrine of faith when regarded from truths Divine; and when regarded from what is rational. Explained... To look from the Word is to look from the Lord; whereas to look from reason and knowledge is to look from man.
I will look to the right or to the left () Explained.
No longer looks at good from truth...
Doctrinal things regard charity as the end.
In Heaven all are regarded from charity and the derivative faith.
The natural man looks to self and the world...

Let Jehovah look between me and thee () = the presence of the Lord's Divine Natural... To look, or to look out = presence; for he who looks at another... is present with him by sight; and besides, to see, when predicated of the Lord, = foresight and Providence, thus also presence...
The name Mizpah is so called from to look.
Regard themselves alone in everything.
Then Knowledges are regarded from this good; and not good from them.
If one were to look towards the east, and the other towards the west, to both the good would appear on the right, and the evil on the left.
When he regards corporeal and worldly things as means...
If the internal man looks downwards... he cannot possibly look upwards...
They no longer regard themselves in everything... but they regard the neighbour, etc.
Scientifics... must regard good as the end.
He then regards good from truth... He then regards truth from good.
These look downwards or outwards, because they are not yet in good. But those who are in good... look upwards or inwards.
Those in Heaven look upwards to the Lord; those in Hell look downwards from Him.
The tail = what is lowest, which looks downwards...
Wild animals look downwards...
He who looks downwards wills evil and thinks falsity.
From himself man looks only downwards...
(After this) man is compelled to look downwards.
All evils and falsities look downwards...
Man can look upwards... A beast looks downwards only. AC 7607.
What it is to look inwards, and to look outwards. Explained. AC 7693:2.
Man has been so created that he can look upwards... or downwards. Explained. AC 7815. AC 7816. AC 7817. AC 7818. AC 7819. AC 7820. AC 7821.
With (the inhabitants of Jupiter) it is unbecoming to be looked at by others, except in front. AC 8373.
When they walk they always... look before them, and never downwards. To look downwards they call damned...
That those in the truth and good of faith conquer when they look upwards to the Lord, and that they yield when they look downwards. Signified. AC 8604, Explained. AC 8608.
Man is distinguished from the brutes in that he can look above himself and below himself...
What is loved is regarded as the end.
The Lord then draws to Himself all things of life with the man, so that they look upwards.
(Good and truth) then mutually regard each other... Then they look backwards or behind them. Signified.
They who read the Word and then look to the Lord...
All in Heaven look to the Lord, for to look forwards there is to look to Him. No one there, however he turns himself, can look backwards from Him.
A man in the spirit can look into the Earth near which he is...
That all things look to one end. Signified, Explained.
Then the man looks downwards; that is, into the world and to self... and whither a man looks, thither his heart turns itself... But when a man becomes spiritual... he looks upwards...
The interiors of the Angels are thus presented visible.

Those who are in externals separated from what is internal... look outwards and downwards... For a man looks inwards or upwards when his internal is open; but he looks outwards or downwards when his internal is closed.
In the other life... those who love the Lord and the neighbour continually look to the Lord...
They looked after Moses () = that they see the external of the Word, etc.
All in the other life look to those things which reign in their interiors...
Those think naturally who look only into the world... But those think spiritually who look to Heaven...
A man, when looked at by the Angels...
When they look thither they do not see them.
So that they had not looked to Heaven, but to the world... For in proportion as the interiors are open the man looks to Heaven; but in proportion as they are closed... he looks to Hell.
He cannot (then) look upwards to Heaven, but only downwards to Hell.
The only means for forming the interiors is that the man looks to the Divine and Heaven... and a man looks to the Divine when he believes in the Divine...
His interiors then look from Heaven to the world, thus backwards.

These can look no otherwise than below themselves, that is, to Hell; and the former no otherwise than above themselves, that is, to Heaven. To look above one's self is to look to the Lord, because He is the common centre to which all things of Heaven look; whereas to look below one's self is to look backwards from the Lord to the opposite centre, to which look and verge all things of Hell.
When men appear (to Spirits)... they do not look at others...
That all things may be regarded by the Divine as its own work, and that all things may at the same time look to the Divine as its work.
Every man who looks to God is taught after death...
Hence they cannot but look to the east...
As he shuns evils as sins, and looks to the Lord. General article. DLW 246.
Hence it is that every man, Spirit, and Angel is regarded by the Lord according to his love or good...
The love of self and of the world looks downwards and outwards; and the love of the Lord looks upwards and inwards.
Such are those who have not looked to God at all in their life. By to look to God in the life is meant to think that this or that evil is a sin against God, and therefore not to do it. DP 93:end.
That the Divine Providence... regards what is infinite and eternal. General article. DP 52. DP 55, Explained. DP 214, General article.
The Divine cannot regard anything else than the Divine... For no one can regard another except from what is his own in him. Explained.
In doing repentance, man must look to the Lord alone. If he looks to God the Father only he cannot be purified; nor if to the Father for the sake of the Son; nor if to the Son as a mere man.
(It is sufficient for man to know that) he must shun evils as sins and look to the Lord.
a [end]. No Angel is allowed to look into lower things from Heaven; but if he likes he may descend.
We two look together... and therefore it is impossible for us to look at any wife of a companion from lust...
The purpose or intention of the will is primarily regarded by the Lord.

Therefore he who looks with his face to the Lord receives from Him wisdom, and through this love; whereas he who looks backwards from the Lord receives love and not wisdom; and love without wisdom is love from man...

Every man... is thus in free will to look upwards to God, or downwards to Hell. If he looks upwards to God, he acknowledges that all wisdom is from God, and as to his spirit he is actually with the Angels in Heaven; whereas he who looks downwards is actually as to his spirit with devils in Hell.
I noticed that those who were actually thinking of three Gods looked towards Hell; and that those who were thinking of one God, in whom is the Divine Trinity... looked towards Heaven.
Regards use as the end.
Regarded in itself. TCR 472.
And looks to the Lord.
On those who look around them. SE 5789. circumspicere. SE 5937. SE 5941. a. SE 5948:2.
The interiors of man... actually look whither his love does.
If he looks to the Lord he is brought out of those Societies...
That the first of charity is to look to the Lord... Char 2.
That every man who looks to the Lord...
Redemption. 5. 3. Those who in the world have looked and turned themselves to Heaven or to Hell, look and turn themselves in the same way after death.
